Generated Narrative: CodeSystem regimen-modification-kind

This case-sensitive code system http://hemonc.org/fhir/CodeSystem/regimen-modification-kind defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
omit-action Omit actionAn action present in the parent is removed (e.g. the fluorouracil bolus).
add-action Add actionAn action absent in the parent is added (e.g. a supportive-care medication).
replace-dose Replace doseSame drug, same schedule, different dose or dose basis (e.g. mg/m² → flat mg).
replace-schedule Replace scheduleSame drug and dose, different days, frequency or infusion duration.
replace-route Replace routeSame drug and dose, different route.
replace-product Replace productDifferent product for the same component (e.g. leucovorin → levoleucovorin).
